inspection.method: All 214 captures for source 7f389bdd were inspected on nine Chrome-rendered contact sheets (24 per sheet, top-aligned crops). Touched surfaces were also viewed at full resolution during the session: the game overview with the club switcher hidden, the one-screen opening contract, the feedback dialog and the job-market overlay. The three new public pages are not in the capture set, so Guides, How It Compares and Screenshots were opened on staging at 390 px dark and 1440 px light and checked for overflow (0 px on all six).
findings: The opening contract is one screen now, so the four tutorial captures (skip, identity, pressure, first call) show the same dialog at different scroll positions on phone and the same view on desktop.
The game overview shows no Controlled Team control under standard rules; the Refresh button sits alone in that row.
The public header on a phone scrolls sideways and shows Updates cut off at the right edge, as the previous label was; no page-level overflow.
Grouped footer, Updates page with Known issues and the 2026-11-17 note render in both themes at both sizes with no overflow or wrapping defect.
Guides, How It Compares and Screenshots are not covered by the capture inventory; adding them is a follow-up.
fixesApplied: A hidden label was still displayed because a display rule overrode the hidden attribute; fixed in the stylesheet before this candidate.
